integrity: Exact matrix-lifting and fourteen invertible binary conjugation witnesses have a standalone replayable verifier; infinite result uses a written induction and finite-state Markov ergodicity, not bounded enumeration.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic densities at each fixed power of two; no uniform quantitative rates across moduli, no other prime moduli, and no independently established publication priority.
title: Exact \(2\)-adic residue densities for semi-Narayana partition numbers
